title: CoolSynth Listening Pass, the kicks
intro: Before 0.5.0: the Kick generator and Succession 808, which you haven't heard yet. Each model plays on its own at its defaults, all four cards at about the same peak; each try turns one knob. Write in the box what you would change.

groups.title: The kicks
groups.intro: The Kick generator holds three models behind one set of knobs: the TR-808's and the TR-909's bass drum circuits, and a modern kick. The key tunes them: these play C2 and A1.

items.title: Succession 808
listen: The 808 under a Succession-style theme, a sound-alike: mono, so each hit strikes the drum still ringing; a 1.3 s boom, darkened and driven. Four bars at 140 BPM on its roots C, Ab, F and G. Its macros: Tone, Punch, Boom, Grit.
items.keys: Its macros: pad Home, page Macros, knobs 1 to 4

items.title: Kick: the 808
listen: The 808's bass drum as its circuit. Against two real 808s I measured its attack a little dull, its click 3 to 6 dB weak, and the real one's shortest Decay out of reach. Does it sound like an 808 to you?

items.title: Kick: the 909

tries.label: Punch Time 30 ms, a slower sweep

listen: The 909's bass drum from its service notes: a swept triangle with its click and a little noise. Measured against real units: its second harmonic 6 dB strong. Click is the 909's ATTACK knob, Punch Time its TUNE.

items.title: Kick: Modern
listen: A clean modern kick: a sine thrown up in pitch and falling to the note, with a short bright click. A new hit picks up from the ringing tail without a step.
